P7525.corridor_notes: This is the '枞阳合建站-枞阳县城天然气高压管线' project: a short high-pressure connector linking the long-distance trunk handover point (枞阳合建站, 'Zongyang co-built/joint station' -- terminology for a station jointly built between the provincial gas company and the long-distance trunk line) to a new gate station (桥港园门站) sited at the Chery Automotive Parts Industrial Park (奇瑞汽车零部件产业园) within the Qiaogang Garden (桥港园) development, southeast Zongyang County town. Zongyang.gov.cn's siting notice for the gate station explicitly states the pipeline 'connects long-distance high-pressure and urban medium-pressure systems' and is 'a key node project for Zongyang County to achieve pipeline natural gas service.' Zongyang Hejian Station's exact site was not directly located; two ahtrq.com (Anhui Natural Gas Development Co.) notices place river-crossing/valve-chamber inspection activity for the related 会宫-枞阳 (Huigong-Zongyang) trunk feeder and the 合建站 itself in the vicinity of 藕山镇, 会宫镇, and especially 官埠桥镇 (site of a 'Guanbu Bridge valve chamber' explicitly tied to the 合建站 inspection route) -- 官埠桥镇 sits between 会宫镇 (the feeder line's origin) and Zongyang's county town, making it the most defensible township-level anchor for the co-built station pending a precise address.
P7525.researcher_notes: GEM's own StartLocation='Zongyang Hejian Station' / EndLocation='Qiaogang Industrial Park' match what was found; the end point is well-corroborated at station-level precision (zongyang.gov.cn's planning-notice public disclosure gives the exact siting description). The start point (Zongyang Hejian Station itself) could only be pinned to township level (官埠桥镇) via two independent ahtrq.com notices that place river-crossing/valve-chamber work tied to the station in that town -- neither gives street-level coordinates or a formal address. LengthMergedKm=7.10km for this row is short and plausible for a co-built-station-to-town-gate-station connector at this scale. No indication this row duplicates any other GEM entry.
P7525.blockers: Zongyang Hejian Station's precise site (as opposed to the general 官埠桥镇 township area) was not located in this pass; a human drawing the route should treat the start coordinate as a loose township-level anchor, not a station pin. The related 会宫-枞阳 (Huigong-Zongyang) trunk feeder line (19km, DN500, feeding into the 合建站 per an ahtrq.com procurement notice) was noted but not researched as its own entity -- it is not one of this batch's assigned PIDs.
